notes.title: The Adventure Continues – Endless RPG: Untold Tales is Here! 🎉
notes.content:
Fellow adventurers, your journey doesn’t end here, it evolves! ⚔️

I’m excited to announce that the next chapter, Endless RPG: Untold Tales, is now in Early Access! 🚀 This second iteration takes everything you loved about the first game and expands it, removing previous limits and offering a true endless adventure.

💡 [b]What’s New?[/b]
✔ [b]No more level caps[/b] – grow stronger than ever!
✔ [b]No 25-day restriction[/b] – explore at your own pace!
✔ [b]Ongoing updates[/b] – bug fixes, new features & more!

A huge thank you to everyone who played and supported the original Endless RPG. Your feedback and love for the game made this sequel possible! 💖

Join the adventure today and help shape the future of Untold Tales!

🔗 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2586000/Endless_RPG__Untold_Tales/]Endless RPG, Untold Tales[/url]

See you on the battlefield! ⚔️✨

notes.title: ⚔️ The Story Continues with Endless RPG - Untold Tales! ⚔️
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers of Endless RPG!

Thank you for embarking on the journey and making Endless RPG such a rewarding experience to create. Now, I’m thrilled to announce that the adventure isn’t over yet!

🎉 Endless RPG - Untold Tales, the next chapter in the Endless RPG series, is here to take the world you love to new heights. With fresh stories, refined mechanics, and even more to explore, it’s the evolution of the Endless adventure!

The demo for Endless RPG - Untold Tales is now live on Steam, and I’d love for you to check it out. Your feedback is vital as we prepare for Early Access!

🕹️ Play the Demo Now
👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2586000/view/518574631175586027?l=english]Demo Link[/url]

Thank you for being part of this incredible journey. Let’s dive into the next chapter together!

notes.title: Endless RPG, Untold Tales, open alpha
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=LwqecnEWV_k;full][/previewyoutube]
Greetings fellow adventurers,

I am thrilled to announce the alpha release of Endless RPG 2's combat system! As you all know, the original Endless RPG had a pretty good reception, and we couldn't have done it without the support and feedback from our incredible community. We are now back with an exciting and innovative combat system that we know you'll love.

With Endless RPG 2's combat system, players will experience a new level of strategy and excitement. We've added new abilities, weapons, and magic spells that will keep you on your toes throughout each battle. You'll have to think tactically and make quick decisions to emerge victorious in each fight.

But that's not all! We've also revamped the character customization options to allow players to create more personalized characters. Choose from an array of races and classes, and then customize their appearance, abilities, and weapons to suit your playstyle.

As an alpha release, we are eager to hear your feedback on the new combat system. We want to know what you love, what you don't, and what we can do to make it even better. Your feedback is crucial to our development process, and we are committed to listening to our community to make Endless RPG 2 the best game it can be.

So, gather your party and prepare for battle! The Endless RPG 2 alpha is now available, and we can't wait for you to experience it. We're excited to hear your feedback and to continue working to create an unforgettable RPG experience.

Thank you for your support, and happy adventuring!

Sincerely,
Kezarus

notes.title: ENDLESS RPG v1.000!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35121121/97d6278770aa8fbb5b8b1b6243dbc87adca4611c.png[/img]

Hello everybody! How are you today? This is it! Endless RPG come to an end of its development with this update! Just as planned and promissed, all features are there. Me and my brother would like to thank each and everyone of you that helped us along the way. Your feedback were invaluable to us. We tried to make things that you suggested and we are sorry for things that we couldn't change.

I will still maintain and correct any bugs that pops up and respond the to questions on the discussion board. I hope you have fun with the game, it's more than 20h (possibily 40h) hours long and it never really ends as you could move your group from a world to another or create another party entirely. =]

These are the features of this version:
[list]
[*]The Root of All Evil: a quest that spawns everytime you destroy an Evil Center or an Evil Agent
[*]Building Quest: you can now give money to a Town for it to build structures
[*]Save System: a save system that is more inline with other mainstream games
[*]Bug Bash:
[list]
[*]Try Save routine, that prevents save files corruption
[*]Grow Bushes skill on top of rocks
[*]Crash on Debug when flee combat
[*]MultiStrike not causing Flank
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Endless RPG Almost Done
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35121121/859020f029fcc0429039fadb09565e4a05b2ffff.png[/img]

Hello everybody! How are you? As December approaches I am happy to announce that we are getting to the end phase of Endless RPG. There are 2 features left:
[list]
[*] The Building Quest: that allows the player to help a town to construct new buildings;
[*] The Root of All Evil: a quest line that will spawn from Evil Centers. When completed that kind of Evil Center will not pop up anymore;
[/list]

I plan to deliver on early December and then move on to new projects. I will, for sure, still address bugs and answer this forum.

It’s been a pleasure to talk to everyone here, thank you so very much for your support. I tried my best to keep up with your expectations and avoid over promising (even if that meant to lose sales). I hope I could achieve that and give you a simple game that is just fun. =]

Stay tuned on the next upcoming update!


Cheers!
Kezarus

Just a small feature that shows a progress bar when you camp.

PRICE EXPLOIT
It's not possible to sell and buy Good Priced items as an exploit strategy anymore.

XP FOR BEING TARGETED
Now, if your character is target by an attack, he/she receives 1 XP based on which armor he/she is wearing.

BUTTON FOR EXIT PARTY SCREEN
Yep. Just that.

I hope you guys enjoy the new small features. If there is any problem or suggestion, let me know. =]


Cheers!
Kezarus

notes.title: Auto Minigame
notes.content:
Hi! Just publish a small feature today. Now you can choose if you want to do the minigames or not. Just go to the Options and set Auto Minigame for Enabled.

Then, when on combat, just choose your attack and the target and your character will perform the attack automatically. Just like XCOM or Battle Brothers. No more need to click at the right time!

So, what are you waiting for? Let's do some battles! =]
